audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Deuteronomy / Devarim second-tablets, Levite vocation, heart-circumcision, and sojourner-justice discourse, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for renewed tablets, ark, travel/death notices, Levite separation, Moses' intercession, covenant requirements, Divine impartiality, orphan/widow justice, and love of the sojourner.

verses.restored: At that time YHWH said to me, Hew for yourself two tablets of stone like first and come up to me on mountain, and make for yourself an ark of wood.

familiar.text: At that time the LORD said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.

modern.text: At that time the LORD said to me, “Chisel out two stone tablets like the originals, come up to Me on the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

original.text: בָּעֵ֨ת הַהִ֜וא אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֣ה אֵלַ֗י פְּסָל לְךָ֞ שְׁנֵֽי לֻוחֹ֤ת אֲבָנִים֙ כָּרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים וַעֲלֵ֥ה אֵלַ֖י הָהָ֑רָה וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לְּךָ֖ אֲר֥וֹן עֵֽץ

verses.restored: I will write on tablets words that were on first tablets you broke, and you shall put them in ark.

familiar.text: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.

modern.text: And I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke; and you are to place them in the ark.”

original.text: וְאֶכְתֹּב֙ עַל הַלֻּחֹ֔ת אֶת הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֛וּ עַל הַלֻּחֹ֥ת הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שִׁבַּ֑רְתָּ וְשַׂמְתָּ֖ם בָּאָרֽוֹן

verses.restored: I made an ark of acacia wood and hewed two tablets of stone like first and went up mountain with two tablets in my hand.

familiar.text: And I made an ark of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.

modern.text: So I made an ark of acacia wood, chiseled out two stone tablets like the originals, and went up the mountain with the two tablets in my hands.

original.text: וָאַ֤עַשׂ אֲרוֹן֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וָאֶפְסֹ֛ל שְׁנֵי לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִ֖ים כָּרִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וָאַ֣עַל הָהָ֔רָה וּשְׁנֵ֥י הַלֻּחֹ֖ת בְּיָדִֽי

verses.restored: He wrote on tablets according to first writing, ten words YHWH spoke to you at mountain from midst of fire on day of assembly, and YHWH gave them to me.

familiar.text: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the LORD gave them unto me.

modern.text: And the LORD wrote on the tablets what had been written previously, the Ten Commandments that He had spoken to you on the mountain out of the fire on the day of the assembly. The LORD gave them to me,

original.text: וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב עַֽל הַלֻּחֹ֜ת כַּמִּכְתָּ֣ב הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן אֵ֚ת עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֲלֵיכֶ֥ם בָּהָ֛ר מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵ֖שׁ בְּי֣וֹם הַקָּהָ֑ל וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָֽי

verses.restored: I turned and came down from mountain and put tablets in ark I made, and there they are, as YHWH commanded me.

familiar.text: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the LORD commanded me.

modern.text: and I went back down the mountain and placed the tablets in the ark I had made, as the LORD had commanded me; and there they have remained.

original.text: וָאֵ֗פֶן וָֽאֵרֵד֙ מִן הָהָ֔ר וָֽאָשִׂם֙ אֶת הַלֻּחֹ֔ת בָּאָר֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי וַיִּ֣הְיוּ שָׁ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוַּ֖נִי יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Children of Israel set out from Beeroth-bene-jaakan to Moserah; there Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar his son served as priest in his place.

familiar.text: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his stead.

modern.text: The Israelites traveled from Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar his son succeeded him as priest.

original.text: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נָֽסְע֛וּ מִבְּאֵרֹ֥ת בְּנֵי יַעֲקָ֖ן מוֹסֵרָ֑ה שָׁ֣ם מֵ֤ת אַהֲרֹן֙ וַיִּקָּבֵ֣ר שָׁ֔ם וַיְכַהֵ֛ן אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו

verses.restored: From there they set out to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of streams of water.

familiar.text: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.

modern.text: From there they traveled to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land with streams of water.

original.text: מִשָּׁ֥ם נָסְע֖וּ הַגֻּדְגֹּ֑דָה וּמִן הַגֻּדְגֹּ֣דָה יָטְבָ֔תָה אֶ֖רֶץ נַ֥חֲלֵי מָֽיִם

verses.restored: At that time YHWH separated tribe of Levi to carry ark of covenant of YHWH, to stand before YHWH to serve him and bless in his name, until this day.

familiar.text: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.

modern.text: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to serve Him, and to pronounce blessings in His name, as they do to this day.

original.text: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗וא הִבְדִּ֤יל יְהוָה֙ אֶת שֵׁ֣בֶט הַלֵּוִ֔י לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֑ה לַעֲמֹד֩ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֤ה לְשָֽׁרְתוֹ֙ וּלְבָרֵ֣ךְ בִּשְׁמ֔וֹ עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: Therefore Levi has no portion or inheritance with his brothers; YHWH is his inheritance, as YHWH your Divine spoke concerning him.

familiar.text: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God promised him.

modern.text: That is why Levi has no portion or inheritance among his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance, as the LORD your God promised him.

original.text: עַל כֵּ֞ן לֹֽא הָיָ֧ה לְלֵוִ֛י חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה עִם אֶחָ֑יו יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לֽוֹ

verses.restored: I remained on mountain as first days, forty days and forty nights, and YHWH listened to me also that time; YHWH was unwilling to destroy you.

familiar.text: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also, and the LORD would not destroy thee.

modern.text: I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights, like the first time, and that time the LORD again listened to me and agreed not to destroy you.

original.text: וְאָנֹכִ֞י עָמַ֣דְתִּי בָהָ֗ר כַּיָּמִים֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י גַּ֚ם בַּפַּ֣עַם הַהִ֔וא לֹא אָבָ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה הַשְׁחִיתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: YHWH said to me, Rise, go for journey before people, and they shall enter and possess land I swore to their fathers to give them.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, take thy journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.

modern.text: Then the LORD said to me, “Get up. Continue your journey ahead of the people, that they may enter and possess the land that I swore to their fathers to give them.” A Call to Obedience (Joshua 24:14–28)

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י ק֛וּם לֵ֥ךְ לְמַסַּ֖ע לִפְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וְיָבֹ֨אוּ֙ וְיִֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶֽם

verses.restored: Now, Israel, what does YHWH your Divine ask from you except to fear/revere YHWH your Divine, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve YHWH your Divine with all your heart and all your soul/life,

familiar.text: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,

modern.text: And now, O Israel, what does the LORD your God ask of you but to fear the LORD your God by walking in all His ways, to love Him, to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

original.text: וְעַתָּה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מָ֚ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ שֹׁאֵ֖ל מֵעִמָּ֑ךְ כִּ֣י אִם לְ֠יִרְאָה אֶת יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ לָלֶ֤כֶת בְּכָל דְּרָכָיו֙ וּלְאַהֲבָ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ וְלַֽעֲבֹד֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכָל לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל נַפְשֶֽׁךָ

verses.restored: to keep commands of YHWH and his statutes that I command you today for your good?

familiar.text: To keep the commandments of the LORD, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?

modern.text: and to keep the commandments and statutes of the LORD that I am giving you this day for your own good?

original.text: לִשְׁמֹ֞ר אֶת מִצְוֺ֤ת יְהוָה֙ וְאֶת חֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם לְט֖וֹב לָֽךְ

verses.restored: Look, to YHWH your Divine belong heavens and heavens of heavens, earth and all that is in it.

familiar.text: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the LORD’s thy God, the earth also, with all that therein is.

modern.text: Behold, to the LORD your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, and the earth and everything in it.

original.text: הֵ֚ן לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּשְׁמֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם הָאָ֖רֶץ וְכָל אֲשֶׁר בָּֽהּ

modern.text: Yet the LORD has set His affection on your fathers and loved them. And He has chosen you, their descendants after them, above all the peoples, even to this day.

original.text: וּמַלְתֶּ֕ם אֵ֖ת עָרְלַ֣ת לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וְעָ֨רְפְּכֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תַקְשׁ֖וּ עֽוֹד

verses.restored: For YHWH your Divine, he is Divine of divines and Lord of lords, great, mighty, and fearsome Divine, who does not lift face/show partiality and does not take bribe.

modern.text: For the LORD your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great, mighty, and awesome God, showing no partiality and accepting no bribe.

original.text: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם ה֚וּא אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַאֲדֹנֵ֖י הָאֲדֹנִ֑ים הָאֵ֨ל הַגָּדֹ֤ל הַגִּבֹּר֙ וְהַנּוֹרָ֔א אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹא יִשָּׂ֣א פָנִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יִקַּ֖ח שֹֽׁחַד

verses.restored: He makes judgment for orphan and widow and loves sojourner, giving him food and clothing.

familiar.text: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.

modern.text: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow, and He loves the foreigner, giving him food and clothing.

original.text: עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט יָת֖וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֑ה וְאֹהֵ֣ב גֵּ֔ר לָ֥תֶת ל֖וֹ לֶ֥חֶם וְשִׂמְלָֽה

modern.text: So you also must love the foreigner, since you yourselves were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

original.text: וַאֲהַבְתֶּ֖ם אֶת הַגֵּ֑ר כִּֽי גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: YHWH your Divine you shall fear/revere, him you shall serve, to him you shall cling, and by his name you shall swear.

familiar.text: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.

modern.text: You are to fear the LORD your God and serve Him. Hold fast to Him and take your oaths in His name.

original.text: אֶת יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ תִּירָ֖א אֹת֣וֹ תַעֲבֹ֑ד וּב֣וֹ תִדְבָּ֔ק וּבִשְׁמ֖וֹ תִּשָּׁבֵֽעַ

verses.restored: He is your praise and he is your Divine, who did with you these great and fearsome things your eyes saw.

familiar.text: He is thy praise, and he is thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.

modern.text: He is your praise and He is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome wonders that your eyes have seen.

original.text: ה֥וּא תְהִלָּתְךָ֖ וְה֣וּא אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֣ה אִתְּךָ֗ אֶת הַגְּדֹלֹ֤ת וְאֶת הַנּֽוֹרָאֹת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָא֖וּ עֵינֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: With seventy souls/lives your fathers went down to Egypt, and now YHWH your Divine has made you like stars of heavens for multitude.

familiar.text: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.

modern.text: Your fathers went down to Egypt, seventy in all, and now the LORD your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky.

original.text: בְּשִׁבְעִ֣ים נֶ֔פֶשׁ יָרְד֥וּ אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ מִצְרָ֑יְמָהּ וְעַתָּ֗ה שָֽׂמְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָרֹֽב

translation_notes: The second tablets embody covenant renewal after rupture; restoration does not erase the broken first tablets or the labor of repair.
The itinerary in verses 6-7 differs from Numbers' sequence and requires source/chronology audit.
Levite vocation is service and dependence rather than superiority; lack of land inheritance creates obligations of communal support.
Circumcision of heart is an internal Jewish covenant metaphor and must not be used for Christian supersessionism or contempt for embodied Jewish circumcision.
Divine greatness is immediately defined through impartial justice for orphan and widow and material love for the sojourner.
Israel must love immigrants because Israel remembers being immigrant and vulnerable in Egypt.
safety_note: Do not use Deuteronomy 10 for antisemitic 'uncircumcised heart' rhetoric, clerical superiority, xenophobia, or coercive assimilation. Its test of covenant reverence is impartial justice, food and clothing for the vulnerable, and active love of the sojourner.
